reviews.text:
I cant speak highly enough of the girls Claire & amy who Maisy loves
maisy is a cockapoo and loves the water
they have worked majic on her with the hydro and the heat massage she has come on leaps since we started with them after what was a bad 12 months with snapped ACL dislocated hip 3months later & torn ACL on the other leg but she is back in form & walking good will never be perfect but I will accept that,
shes still here.
I wish you the very best in all your new adventures and the future going forward
regards
mary & maisy
Ellen was so helpful and did an amazing groom on Molly

I have 2 dogs with 2 very different personalities!  Ellen has been grooming both of them now for the last 6 months and she is amazing.  She has a calming influence on the dogs and me and when I collect them they always look great.  Super service!!!
Thank you :)
Thank you Ellen at the Canine Clinic for doing a great job grooming Jeff. He’s not the easiest terrier but you managed him so well 👏 …

My first experience at the Canine Clinic my Dog Ruby is a West highland Terrier.She is quite old and Ellen was so patient and professional with her as she gets very anxious .I would trust anyone that has this problem please give Ellen a go because she was so kind and professional with Ruby.I will definitely be using her again she is fantastic at her job and rang me half way through it to explain her severe anxiety which I personally thought was beyond professional and she is very caring YOURS SINCERELY MARY WALSH.

What a wonderful facility for our dogs
The care and attention is just outstanding. Special mention to the wonderful Sarah - her caring profesionalism is why clients return. Thank you Sarah.
Great service and care for our today today when grooming. Ellen really listened to what we wanted for our pet

Gyuri, our lovely Hungarian Vizsla boy was diagnosed around 6mo age with hip dysplasia. Claire has been instrumental to his welfare, pain management and making sure he`s doing well. On top of this, he simply ADORES her and enjoys the sessions with her. He will sit patiently as he trusts her fully to manipulate, spot pain and address it so that he can be the crazy giddy boy again. Claire has helped with building the muscle mass he needed and we`re always going for maintenance there.

Thanks Claire!
Ellen did a great job with Elly 😊 First groom with her and even though I’m sure Elly gave her some trouble the haircut is super cute …

I would like to share my deepest gratitude for the exceptional care Sarah provides at The Canine Clinic. Managing a grade five osteoarthritis diagnosis in a high-energy breed like a Springer Spaniel is daunting, but Sarah has handled my boy with such skill and compassion.
​The physical results speak for themselves, but the emotional change is what moves me most. Seeing him bounce in and out of the clinic—full of vitality and relief—is a testament to her talent. She hasn't just managed his pain; she has improved his quality of life immensely.

My young dog and my senior dog attend here frequently. Clare is brilliant with them both. She does an amazing job. Ruby my 15 year old thrives after each visit. She can now do little gallops and walks so much better. Gives me so much hope for her as she was quite unwell when she started last year. The difference is astonishing.
With my little dachshund Clare is helping him with a luxating patella and his long spine. I am so very grateful and would highly recommend.

The Canine Clinic was recommended to me by another dog owner when Goose just had ACL surgery. I contacted them straight away, and Claire and her team have been supporting us ever since, over three years now.

Claire was incredible throughout Goose’s ACL recovery and has continued to support Goose with arthritis management and the odd niggle when she’s overdone it. More recently, following a tough diagnosis, I know Claire and the team are providing Goose with the most personal, knowledgeable, and genuinely compassionate care, helping her stay mobile, comfortable and as strong as possible.

I’m incredibly grateful for everything they continue to do for Goose and her human.

Claire is an absolute angel. My dog has gone through back surgery on two occasions and Claire has worked wonders with him, helping him to regain his confidence and his overall strength. Alfie is very comfortable and happy with Claire and loves his time in the pool with her. I would highly recommend Claire

Fabulous facility.  Ruby loves going here.  The girls are so good with the dogs and know there limitations.

If you have a dog with movement or hip issues I would definitely recommend the Canine clinic.

I have brought my Bernese Mountain dog to the Canine Clinic over the past few years. Each visit has been a very pleasant experience for our dog and she looks forward to the massage and warm pool sessions. I have full confidence in Claire, the physiotherapist and after a few sessions our dog shows a big improvement.

I brought my 11.5 year old rescue greyhound to the clinic as my girl is getting older and needs extra support in her movement for stiffness and arthritis.  Claire was fabulous really listening to my concerns and so gentle with her as she was nervous.  Well my girl bounded out to greet me so happy after her hydrotherapy and other treatments, Claire had worked her magic.  My girl jumped into back car which she hasn't done in very long time.  I highly recommend the canine clinic. 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Claire is superb and as a consequence Dotty is pain free (no surgery needed) and happy. Can’t recommend enough.
Super experience. Brought my second dog into the Canine Clinic and there was no doubt you could see the improvement afterwards.
Been going here for years, completely trust them with my Rottweiler and it's made such a difference.

Would highly recommend the quality of care at the Canine Clinic. Winnie is thriving after two ACL operations due mainly to the enormous efforts of Claire and her team...we would be lost without them!!

I have been taking my 7yr old Jack Russell, Maisie,to Clare for the past 4 years. Maisie blew a disc in her back and became paralysed from her waste down. After successful surgery she was advised to have physio and hydrotherapy to help her with her deficits.. Clare has helped Maisie to get back to being a normal happy dog again. Maisie loves her little visits to Clare. It's not treatment to Maisie , it's a session of love and  pampering. Clare treats Maisie with such kindness and care. She is a God send to any dog who has the bad fortune of having  an accident or ill health and needs her care. She  and the team at The Canine Clinic are true professionals who treat their patients with such kindness and love. I wouldn't have any hesitation in highly recommending  The Canine Clinic in treating your Fur Puppy . XXX Maisie chilling having her lazer treatment.

We have been working with Claire for 7 years and the difference it makes for Marley our Lab/Bernese Mountain Dog X  is really extraordinary. Hydrotherapy gives such great results and I can’t recommend The Canine Clinic more! So grateful.

As someone who works with dogs every day, I can honestly say The Canine Clinic is exceptional. I take my own dog there and have seen such a difference — the care, attention, and expertise are second to none. Every session is handled with genuine kindness and professionalism, and my dog absolutely loves going!

I also hear nothing but positive feedback from my others who use The Canine Clinic, which just reinforces how consistently brilliant they are.

I recommend them to everyone — whether it’s for recovery, mobility, or just keeping your dog feeling their best, they’re truly the best in the business!

I can’t recommend Claire and the team at The Canine Clinic highly enough! From the moment we walked in, we were made to feel so welcome and at ease. Blu absolutely adores her sessions (as did Ruby when she was still with us). Blu is a nervous dog and doesn’t like new places, noises, smells etc. but she literally pulls me into the clinic - she jumps out of the car and runs inside!

You can tell how much care and expertise goes into every treatment. The improvement we’ve seen in our dogs’ movement and comfort has been incredible, and it’s clear that Claire and all the team genuinely loves what they do.

It’s such a relief knowing our dog is in such kind and knowledgeable hands. Thank you for everything you’ve done to help Blu feel her best again, and for making Ruby feel so good in her final weeks! 🐾💛
Excellent grooming service! Could not recommend more 👍 …

I brought Romeo to Cáit for a groom last Friday at the canine clinic. I can honestly say it was the best groom he has ever had. So so handsome. Romeo is usually out of sorts, stressed and hyper after grooming and he was so calm and very much himself after his experience with Cait. Thanks for all the great work you all do at the canine clinic. 💕

This is the place to go. My old lady stopped walking one day. After starting hydrotherapy she is a different dog now, that can not only walk normally but also runs and climb the stairs. It's not life changing, it's life SAVING. can't praise them enough. Always on time, the girls are absolutely lovely and knowledgeable and you can tell they're passionate. Amy is looking after our girl and she's absolutely brilliant.
We aso had our dog groomed recently and it was AMAZING. Emer took such a good care of her, that we couldn't believe our eyes when we saw the difference. RECOMMEND 1100%.
Worth travelling all the way down from Kerry.

Got our dog Pip from the CSPCA and noticed that he was a bit limpy, the vet x-rayed him and diagnosed hip dysplasia and suggested physio might help. After a few sessions with Claire the difference was notable. Runs around like the 2 year old he should be now. Would recommend highly.

Amazing Experience🤩
I recently took my 8-year-old Jack Russell Terrier mix, Lily, to The Canine Clinic for hydrotherapy combined with physiotherapy, just 3.5 weeks after her knee tendon surgery, and the results have been incredible! The staff were professional, compassionate, and truly cared about Lily's well-being🥰The facilities were clean, welcoming, and well-equipped, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.

After just one session, we could already see improvement!😳Lily started using her paw again,which is a huge milestone for us! 💪The therapy was gentle yet effective, and I can already tell it’s making a real difference in her mobility. I’m so grateful for the team at The Canine Clinic for their expertise and care🥰

I highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner looking for high-quality therapy for their furry friend. Thank you to everyone at The Canine Clinic for making such a positive impact on Lily’s recovery!

My border collie Kim who has hip dysplasia regularly attends the Canine Clinic. Her pain management programme incorporates  hydro-physiotherapies, and recommended home exercises and adaptations.
Kim is responding well to her treatment which significantly reduces any pain and discomfort.  From the outset, her mobility and flexibility improved significantly.
Claire is lovely! She is professional, dedicated, experienced and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend her.
More like a 5 star spa for our Viszla. Claire is always awesome and careful with him, it's really a joy for us and our pet to bring him there, knowing he gets the golden standard in treatment/fun.

Thanks to Claire, our Golden Retriever, Jangles had a long and happy life. She lived to 15 and that was all thanks to Claire who helped her with her mobility issues for the last 5 years of her life. The pool set up is fantastic for dogs and really allows the physio to get the joints moving and work on specific movement for them. I couldn't recommend The Canine Clinic highly enough. An added bonus is that Claire is really nice to deal with aswell.

Our 12year old golden retriever Rebel has arthritis and we were recommended to bring him to the Canine Clinic.
We can't speak highly enough of Claire.
The transformation has been like night and day. His movement is much better and he really enjoys the experience. Day 1 he had to be coaxed in but Claires gentle nature put him at ease and now he loves his visits.
We're so grateful to Claire for all her work with Rebel. He has a new lease of life.

I cannot speak highly enough about the work Claire does. After our 10 year old dog had two surgeries on his cruciate, he unfortunately didn’t heal so well after the second surgery. We were so thankfully referred to canine clinic where Claire didn’t shy away from our dog’s condition. With her clear guidance and hard work with Theo we have seen the most drastic change in the quality of his life. He runs in her door for every appointment and can’t get in the pool quick enough because of how kind and gentle Claire and her whole team are each time he attends the clinic.

Claire and the wonderful team at the canine clinic are absolutely sublime. Our poochon Theo who is 10 years old had cruciate surgery on both of his back legs, each surgery being 8 months apart. Theo has also had luxating patella’s since he was a puppy, which initially caused no problems but after two surgery’s these also became an issue. The second surgery took a toll on Theo and we were referred to Claire. I wish we had been referred after the first surgery because Claire has changed Theo’s life. He was almost 3kg overweight at the time and we worked hard with Claire’s guidance and advice to get this down so that Theo could feel the full benefit of this therapy. We began weekly hydrotherapy for 8 weeks and then Theo graduated to once monthly therapy after improving so drastically. He went from really struggling on his short walks to now wanting to walk for longer and longer periods. He is such a happy dog and has so much energy, he loves to see Claire each month and we cannot thank her and her team enough for all they did for Theo!

Holly our Labrador had severe difficulty walking and was in a lot of pain and discomfort. She was diagnosed with arthritis and our vet put her on medication for this but also recommended Claire in the Canine Clinic. Holly started attending Claire aged 10 for 4 years and the difference in her mobility was incredible. Her quality of life improved hugely and she knew when she was always so excited going for her swimming sessions with Claire. I noticed a remarkable difference in the muscle tone in her back legs thanks to the exercises Claire was doing with her. I would highly recommend Claire; she has a wonderful way with dogs and gave Holly the very best of care.
